scripts.test:recognition: for test in recognition-provider recognition-state; do esbuild test/$test.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.$test-test.mjs >/dev/null && node .$test-test.mjs && rm .$test-test.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test:storage: for test in storage-quota storage-ui; do esbuild test/$test.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=.$test-test.mjs >/dev/null && node .$test-test.mjs && rm .$test-test.mjs || exit 1; done
scripts.test: pnpm run test:upload && pnpm run test:admin && pnpm run test:auth && pnpm run test:recognition && pnpm run test:sharing && pnpm run test:downloads && pnpm run test:tenancy && pnpm run test:storage
scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm exec vite build
scripts.deploy: pnpm run check && pnpm exec wrangler deploy
